response.sql: SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS value FROM (SELECT mt.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS type_avg FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name);

assumptions.assumption: Milliseconds is never zero for the qualifying tracks, since the schema allows any positive integer but does not enforce it and the request does not address zero-length tracks.
Bytes ÷ Milliseconds is real-valued division (the 1.0 multiplier avoids SQLite's integer division), which the request's per-millisecond average implies.
Media types are grouped by Name, as the request specifies, so two media types sharing a name would be combined.
